missing: Three refutations. (1) The gate judges declared expectations, not output: CandidateArtifact has no field for what the candidate produced, so a patch with wrong output passes as long as its declared expectations are a subset of the suite's (vc_201_005_mastery_wrong_output_still_passes_the_gate). (2) A candidate that did nothing passes — an empty expected_results is trivially a subset (vc_201_005_mastery_empty_candidate_passes). (3) The write-permission separation is asserted, not enforced: candidate_can_write is a caller-supplied bool and the artifact is a plain struct (vc_201_005_mastery_write_boundary_is_a_caller_flag). Additionally eval_separation has no production caller and 'held-out inputs' are just a struct field — no isolation mechanism exists. Holds: invented expectations absent from the suite fail, and the write flag fails closed (vc_201_005_mastery_invented_expectations_and_write_flag_fail).
